desc: Derive the exact greedy feasibility check for a target minimum score \(X\), including how visits to position \(i\) affect positions \(i-1\) and \(i+1\).
Prove the move-count formula for handling repeated visits while scanning the array from left to right, including the final-position boundary case.
Implement binary search over \(X\), choosing safe lower and upper bounds and ensuring all calculations use Python integers.
Validate the algorithm on the provided examples and edge cases such as \(m<n\), very large point values, and targets requiring zero or many repeated visits.
Produce the final `Solution.maxScore` implementation with the required imports/type annotations and \(O(n\log(\text{answer}))\) complexity.
